Name: Grandpa's Inheritance
Author: Hemptress
Description:
A story-focused inheritance mod where Grandpa sends one final letter to help you bring Grandma’s farm dream to life.

What this mod does

[list]
[*]On Spring 3 (or the next available day if installed later), Grandpa’s letter appears.
[*]When you read it, Grandpa’s lawyer deposits 99,999 g into your account.
[*]The letter also includes a starter package of attached items.
[/list]Starter Package
[list]
[*]1x Training Rod
[*]1x Fish Smoker
[*]5x Chest
[*]1x Furnace
[*]1x Copper Pickaxe
[*]1x Scarecrow
[*]8x Quality Sprinkler
[*]4x Tapper
[*]1x Charcoal Kiln
[*]1x Mayonnaise Machine
[*]10x Lucky Lunch
[*]1x Seed Maker
[*]64x Quality Fertilizer
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]No dependency mods needed
[/list]Installation
[list=1]
[*]Extract the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI
[/list]Notes
[list]
[*]Triggers once per save.
[*]In multiplayer, it applies to the main player/host.
[/list]
This is my first mod, so please be kind. Future updates are coming soon!

Downloads.Description: The main mod for Grandpa's Inheritance. No mod dependencies. Standalone as of v1.0.0. Will be adding updates in the future!
